table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Manufacturer=M.Name,
	ICode = I.ICode,
	ItemAliasName=I.CustomICode,
	ItemName=I.Name,
	QuotedQty = CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Q.QuotedQty + Q.QuotedBonus) / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits > 0 THEN I.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 0) AS INT),
	QuotedQtyLoose = CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Q.QuotedQty + Q.QuotedBonus), 0) AS INT) % CASE WHEN I.PackUnits > 0 THEN I.PackUnits ELSE 1 END,
	SoldQty = CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Q.SoldQty + Q.SoldBonus) / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits > 0 THEN I.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 0) AS INT),
	SoldQtyLoose = CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Q.SoldQty + Q.SoldBonus), 0) AS INT) % CASE WHEN I.PackUnits > 0 THEN I.PackUnits ELSE 1 END,
	NetQty = CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Q.QuotedQty + Q.QuotedBonus - Q.SoldQty - Q.SoldBonus) / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits > 0 THEN I.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 0) AS INT),
	NetQtyLoose = CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Q.QuotedQty + Q.QuotedBonus - Q.SoldQty - Q.SoldBonus), 0) AS INT) % CASE WHEN I.PackUnits > 0 THEN I.PackUnits ELSE 1 END
FROM
	Item I,
	Manufacturer M,
	Accounts A,
	(SELECT 
		QuotationCode = QH.QuotationCode,
		Date = QH.Date,
		Remarks = QH.Remarks,
		CustCode=QH.CustCode,
		ICode = QD.ICode,
		QuotedQty = ISNULL(SUM(QD.Qty * CASE QH.LoosePack WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE QD.PackUnits END), 0),
		QuotedBonus = ISNULL(SUM(QD.BonusQty * CASE QH.LoosePack WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE QD.PackUnits END), 0),
		SoldQty = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(SD.LooseQty) 
			FROM SaleDetail SD, SaleLedger SL 
			WHERE SL.QuotationNo = QH.QuotationCode AND
				SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
				SD.ICode = QD.ICode), 0),
		SoldBonus = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(SD.BonusQty) 
			FROM SaleDetail SD, SaleLedger SL 
			WHERE SL.QuotationNo = QH.QuotationCode AND
				SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
				SD.ICode = QD.ICode), 0)
	FROM
		QuotationDetail QD,
		QuotationHeader QH
	WHERE
		QH.QuotationCode IN (:ai_quotationcode) AND
		QH.QuotationCode = QD.QuotationCode
	GROUP BY
		QH.QuotationCode,
		QH.Date,
		QH.Remarks,
		QH.CustCode,
		QD.ICode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		QuotationCode = QH.QuotationCode,
		Date = QH.Date,
		Remarks = QH.Remarks,
		CustCode = QH.CustCode,
		ICode = SD.ICode,
		QuotedQty = 0.0000,
		QuotedBonus = 0.0000,
		SoldQty = ISNULL(SUM(SD.LooseQty), 0),
		SoldBonus = ISNULL(SUM(SD.BonusQty), 0)
	FROM
		SaleDetail SD,
		SaleLedger SL, 
		QuotationHeader QH
	WHERE
		QH.QuotationCode IN (:ai_quotationcode) AND
		QH.QuotationCode = SL.QuotationNO AND
		SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
		SD.ICode NOT IN (SELECT QD.ICode FROM QuotationDetail QD WHERE QD.QuotationCode = QH.QuotationCode)
	GROUP BY
		QH.QuotationCode,
		QH.Date,
		QH.Remarks,
		QH.CustCode,
		SD.ICode) Q
WHERE
	(Q.QuotedQty - Q.SoldQty <> 0 OR Q.QuotedBonus - Q.SoldBonus <> 0) AND
	Q.ICode = I.ICode AND
	Q.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode
GROUP BY
	I.ICode,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	I.PackUnits,
	M.Name
